Yes. You already have half of this, and the missing piece is a **cheap URL-liveness probe**, not another country scrape.

## What already happens

On a **successful** company board scrape, merge treats “not on this board anymore” as closed: it sets `closed_at` and keeps the row. Public `/jobs/<slug>` then returns **410**, drops JSON-LD, and leaves `/sitemap-jobs.xml`. That is the right catalog field. Do not write per-user `not_for_me_reason=expired` from a worker — that flag is human hide-on-the-board, and the backlog still calls automatic expiry out of scope.

The website can still show dead roles because:

1. **Failed fetch never closes anything.** `fetch_problem` companies keep empty `closed_at`, so kuchup.com stays **200**.
2. **Board absence is a weak signal.** Merge compares against the **filtered** list (title + location gate). A still-open role that fails those gates looks closed. A closed role that the ATS still lists looks open.
3. **The panel ignores `closed_at`.** Stale jobs stay on the board until someone picks Expired.
4. **The public catalog API ignores it too.** `list_sponsored_catalog_jobs` only filters `visa_sponsorship = 1`, so closed visa roles can still appear in public listings.

Checking kuchup.com itself cannot find closures. Those pages only know what Postgres already stored.

## Recommended job

A separate fetch-worker cycle that probes the **employer URL** already on `matching_jobs.url` — the posting you wrap on `/jobs/<slug>`.

**Who to probe:** open public listings first (`visa_sponsorship = 1`, `closed_at` empty, slug present). That is the LinkedIn/Google surface. Widen to the rest of the catalog later if the board should hide them too.

**What “closed” means (conservative):**

| Treat as closed | Treat as unknown (retry later) |
|---|---|
| 404 / 410 | timeout, 5xx, 429, 403 |
| Greenhouse / Lever / Ashby “not found” | captcha / Playwright-only pages |
| Clear “no longer available” / “position filled” copy | empty body, homepage redirect without a strong signal |

Require **two consecutive closed probes**, or closed probe **plus** missing from the last successful board scrape. One flaky 404 should not 410 a live LinkedIn wrap.

**What to write:** set `closed_at`. Existing merge already clears it if the role comes back. Hide by filtering that column — public pages already do; board and `list_sponsored_catalog_jobs` do not yet.

Keep this **httpx-only**, low concurrency, oldest `last_seen` first, cap per cycle. Same `relocation-fetch-worker` container, different loop (offset from the 6h country scrape). Do not hang it on enrich: enrich is `only_missing` and already treats empty text as “skip,” not “gone.” Do not add Playwright here; that box is already at `FETCH_SCHEDULE_CONCURRENCY=2`.

## Two product calls

**Public site:** catalog fact. Closed → 410 + out of sitemap + out of public job lists. That should be automatic.

**Panel:** I would hide closed rows from the main open board for everyone (same as a catalog fact), but leave them visible if the user already applied / looking-to-apply. Auto-writing Expired into `job_tracking` for every user duplicates a shared fact into N overlays.

## What I would not do

- Infer closed only from “missing on this scrape” (you already do that; it is the noisy path).
- HEAD-only without ATS-aware GET — many boards 200 a “sorry, filled” page.
- Age-out by `validThrough` (today `datePosted + 30 days` while still open). That lies to crawlers and does not mean the ATS closed.

If you want this built next, the first slice is: probe open public slugs → set `closed_at` → filter the sponsored public list. Panel hide can follow once that is trusted. Switch to Agent mode and say which surface is leaking (LinkedIn `/jobs` pages, panel board, or both).

# Listing close probe

## Problem

Public `/jobs/<slug>` and the panel still show roles the employer has taken down.

`closed_at` already exists and public pages already 410 when it is set ([`job-syndication.md`](docs/reference/job-syndication.md)). Three gaps:

- It is only set when a **successful** board scrape drops the URL ([`scrape/merge.py`](relocation_jobs/scrape/merge.py)). Failed fetches leave pages at 200.
- Board SQL **does not load** `closed_at` ([`_JOB_LIST_COLUMNS`](relocation_jobs/catalog/repo.py) around line 176), so the panel cannot hide merge-closed jobs even today.
- Public preview queries (`list_sponsored_catalog_jobs`, `list_sponsored_catalog_companies`) ignore `closed_at`.

Do not write per-user `not_for_me_reason=expired`. That stays a human hide. Catalog fact is `closed_at`.

Do not probe kuchup.com. Probe `matching_jobs.url` (the ATS posting).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  sched[fetch-worker cycle]
  probe[listing_check httpx]
  countries[existing country scrape]
  db[(matching_jobs.closed_at)]
  public["/jobs slug 410 and sitemap"]
  panel[panel main board]
  sched --> probe --> db
  sched --> countries --> db
  db --> public
  db --> panel
```

## Probe (fetch-worker)

Run **before** country scrapes inside [`run_fetch_cycle`](relocation_jobs/fetch/scheduler.py) so public 410s do not wait on Playwright. Same process, same `fetch_is_running` lock, **httpx only** (reuse [`make_fetch_client`](relocation_jobs/fetch/client.py)). No Playwright.

New pipeline: [`relocation_jobs/fetch/listing_check.py`](relocation_jobs/fetch/listing_check.py)

New classifier: [`relocation_jobs/scrape/listing_status.py`](relocation_jobs/scrape/listing_status.py) — `open | closed | unknown`. No SQL.

**Candidates** (repo query, cap per cycle, default 200): open rows (`closed_at` empty, URL present), **public visa+slug first**, then oldest `last_seen`. Join `companies.ats_type`.

**Closed (count as a miss):** HTTP 404/410; Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby detail API not-found; 200 body with a small fixed phrase list (`no longer available`, `position has been filled`, `job not found`).

**Unknown (no change):** timeout, 429, 403, 5xx, empty body, generic 200 without a closed phrase. Redirect-to-careers-home is unknown in v1 (too many false positives).

**Open:** ATS detail 200 with content, or generic 200 without closed phrases (resets miss count only; does not clear `closed_at` — merge still reopens).

**Two misses then close:** new column `listing_misses INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`. Increment on closed, reset on open, set `closed_at` when misses >= 2. Merge `_update_from_scrape` already clears `closed_at`; also reset `listing_misses` there.

Env (defaults on when `FETCH_SCHEDULE_ENABLED=1`):

- `FETCH_LISTING_CHECK_ENABLED` (default on)
- `FETCH_LISTING_CHECK_LIMIT=200`
- `FETCH_LISTING_CHECK_CONCURRENCY=2` (same budget as country fetch)
- `FETCH_LISTING_CHECK_MISSES=2`

`--once` runs the probe then the country cycle. Log counts: probed / closed / unknown. Invalidate country cache after writes ([`invalidate_country_cache`](relocation_jobs/catalog/cache.py)).

## Catalog writes and reads

Migration `catalog_listing_check_v1` in [`catalog/schema.py`](relocation_jobs/catalog/schema.py): `listing_misses`.

[`catalog/repo.py`](relocation_jobs/catalog/repo.py):

- Add `closed_at` (and `listing_misses` if needed) to `_JOB_LIST_COLUMNS` / `_JOB_LIST_COLUMNS_J` / `_job_stats_row` so the board actually sees it.
- `list_open_jobs_for_listing_check(limit)`
- `apply_listing_check_results(rows)` — SQL only here
- Filter `closed_at` empty in `list_sponsored_catalog_jobs` and `list_sponsored_catalog_companies` (and visa counts that feed homepage preview)

Existing `get_public_job_by_slug` + sitemap query stay as they are.

## Panel hide

In [`partition_stored_jobs`](relocation_jobs/panel/flatten_jobs.py) and `partition_stored_jobs_for_stats`: if `job_is_closed(job)` and the user is **not** applied and **not** looking-to-apply, skip the row (do not put it in `not_for_me_jobs`). `hide_empty` then drops companies that only have dead untracked roles.

Pass `closed_at` through [`job_dict`](relocation_jobs/panel/tracking.py) so kept applied / looking-to-apply cards can show a closed state. No auto-Expired tracking writes.

Same skip in company workspace listing ([`mcp/service.py`](relocation_jobs/mcp/service.py) `get_company_applications` / `_company_position_from_job`): closed + not engaged → omit.

## Docs

- [`docs/reference/job-syndication.md`](docs/reference/job-syndication.md) — probe as the second closer besides merge
- [`docs/reference/business-rules.md`](docs/reference/business-rules.md) — scrape still does not delete; public + board hide on `closed_at`; engaged rows stay
- [`docs/backlog.md`](docs/backlog.md) — automatic expiry is this job, not per-user Expired
- [`docs/operations/ec2-panel.md`](docs/operations/ec2-panel.md) — env knobs (placeholders only)

## Tests

- `tests/scrape/test_listing_status.py` — 404 closed, 429 unknown, 200 closed-copy, Greenhouse 404 vs 200
- `tests/fetch/test_listing_check.py` — two misses set `closed_at`; one miss does not; unknown does not increment; open resets misses; cache invalidation
- `tests/scrape/test_merge.py` — rescrape clears `closed_at` and `listing_misses`
- `tests/panel/test_jobs.py` — closed hidden; applied / looking-to-apply kept
- `tests/panel/test_hide_empty.py` — company with only closed jobs skipped
- `tests/web/test_public_api.py` — preview omits closed visa rows
- `tests/catalog/test_public_jobs.py` — already covers 410; keep
- `tests/fetch/test_scheduler.py` — cycle invokes listing check when enabled

No live ATS calls in tests; fake httpx responses.
